tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page, slide and card background. The only background the system uses on light surfaces. Site dark: warm graphite for the website pages between film chapters, never pure black.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, doc previews. Sits on ground. Site dark: the one lighter step, blended in and out over 30 percent of a section.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, text inside glass, the mark. 15.9:1 on ground.

tokens.name: body
tokens.usage: Running text at 17px. 8.9:1 on ground.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Captions, small text, labels inside panels. 6.1:1 on ground.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: 12px caps labels only. 3.5:1 on ground, never body text.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Rules, borders, gridlines. Lists are hairline rows, not cards.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Primary action, one accent word, links, chart accent series. At most twice per surface. On the Film theme it is 3.4:1 on ground, so it is a fill there, never text: use blue-light.

tokens.name: blue-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the primary pill. Colour only, nothing moves.

tokens.name: blue-light
tokens.usage: Accent word on film and dark photography only. 6.7:1 on ink. Never text on white or ground. The only blue on the Site dark pages: eyebrows, the accent word, the menu action.

tokens.name: blue-tint
tokens.usage: Selected chip fill, with blue text.

tokens.name: chart-accent
tokens.usage: The one highlighted series in a native chart.

tokens.name: chart-comparison
tokens.usage: Comparison series. 2.8:1 on white: never text.

tokens.name: chart-step-1
tokens.usage: Third series, further from the point.

tokens.name: chart-step-2
tokens.usage: Fourth series.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Hairline gridlines. One axis only.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Rises from the bottom of a photograph over 55% of its height, under type.

tokens.name: glass-tint-top
tokens.usage: Top of a glass panel's vertical tint.

tokens.name: glass-tint-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom of the tint. The floor: below 26% ink drops under 4.5:1.

tokens.name: glass-dark-top
tokens.usage: Dark plate, for photographs darker than mid grey.

tokens.name: glass-dark-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom of the dark plate tint.

tokens.name: glass-nav
tokens.usage: Nav bar variant: square, 18px blur, hairline beneath.

tokens.name: glass-rim
tokens.usage: The 1px rim lit from above, fading to 12% at the sides.

tokens.name: bloom-blue
tokens.usage: The large blue bloom behind a ground layout, at 18% and 120px blur.

tokens.name: bloom-warm
tokens.usage: The warm bloom, at 15%. Glass on flat ground needs light to bend.

tokens.name: film-host-page
tokens.usage: The host page in the product film. Never a pure white page.

tokens.name: film-host-paper
tokens.usage: The host's paper surface in the product film.

tokens.name: endcard-black
tokens.usage: The endcard plate after the lockup lands.

tokens.name: glass-dark-panel
tokens.usage: Dark glass for the menu and contact dialog on the Site dark edition, 30px blur, off-white type.

tokens.name: nav-glass-dark
tokens.usage: The scrolled nav on the Site dark edition, 24px blur, a 8 percent white hairline beneath.

tokens.name: answer-glow
tokens.usage: The soft text glow on the last word of an answer, with a 35 percent blue-light halo. Never an underline.

families.sans: "Inter", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Site and cover display. Fluid: clamp 40px to 6.4vw to 84px.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Section headlines. Fluid: clamp 30px to 4vw to 48px. Breaks at 14ch.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: One memory for the whole of a life.
styles.usage: The lead beside a section headline. 17 to 19px, measure 56ch.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: It remembers why, not just what.
styles.usage: Running text. Measure 64ch. The smallest size body text ever takes.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: The only uppercase in the system. Always in faint or muted.

styles.name: film-headline
styles.usage: On a 1920 frame: 5.6vw, left rail, bottom 5.6vw. One accent word in blue-light.

styles.name: film-second-line
styles.sample: Mail read, calendar moved, coffee still hot.
styles.usage: 0.42em of the film headline, white at 78%.

styles.name: ask
styles.usage: The person's own words in the ask bar. Solid caret, no placeholder.

styles.name: ask-answer
styles.usage: One line back, 108px below the bar's centre, white over the picture, never boxed.

spacing.note: A 4px base. Nothing is placed on a number that is not on this scale. The page gutter is max(20px, 6.9vw) and is not a fixed step.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps, the 6px chip dot's surround.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips, between initials.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Label to line, caption to stage.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inside a doc preview.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between stages.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding, grid gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between component rows.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section head to content.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Between sections on a phone.

tokens.name: space-30
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop.

radius.note: Tightened in v1.6 so glass reads as a slab, not a pebble.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Glass panels, photograph stages, big surfaces.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Stages, surfaces, component cards, inputs, application tiles.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Tiles and the ask bar's mark chip.

tokens.name: radius-doc
tokens.usage: Doc previews and list-row hover.

tokens.name: radius-ask
tokens.usage: The ask bar in the product film at 1920. On the site the bar takes radius-glass.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Toggles, avatars and status dots only. Buttons, fields and bars are never pills (retired on the site in 2.1).

tokens.name: radius-frame
tokens.usage: Film frames on light pages, the phone frames, the site's large media.

tokens.name: radius-glass
tokens.usage: The hero bar, the answer card, the waitlist field and every glass card on the site. One radius through every state; nothing is a pill (1.9cqw inside the hero).

tokens.name: radius-inner
tokens.usage: Buttons, tiles and the send button inside glass, concentric with radius-glass. Contact us, Join the waitlist.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Glass over a photograph: the rim, plus the deep cast.

tokens.name: shadow-glass-ground
tokens.usage: Glass on the grey ground: the same rim, a lighter cast.

tokens.name: shadow-doc
tokens.usage: The doc preview inside a message panel.

tokens.name: shadow-ask
tokens.usage: The ask bar over a photograph.

tokens.name: shadow-stage
tokens.usage: A slide, a browser frame or a card lifted off the ground.

tokens.name: shadow-knob
tokens.usage: The toggle knob.

opacity.note: Motion values are not tokens; they are in the Motion section of the brand book.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled state. Same colour, no grey substitute, pointer events off.

tokens.name: opacity-bloom-blue
tokens.usage: The blue bloom behind a ground layout.

tokens.name: opacity-bloom-warm
tokens.usage: The warm bloom.

tokens.name: opacity-scrim
tokens.usage: The photographic scrim at its foot.

tokens.name: opacity-second-line
tokens.usage: White second line under a film headline.

tokens.name: opacity-film-vignette
tokens.usage: The host's edge vignette in the product film.

tokens.name: opacity-endcard-atmosphere
tokens.usage: Brand-blue atmosphere breathing in behind the endcard lockup.
